newsitem.title: USA: M/I Schottenstein to buy back family shares.
newsitem.headline: M/I Schottenstein to buy back family shares.

text.p: M/I Schottenstein Homes Inc said Thursday that it has agreed in principle to repurchase 702,439 shares of common stock from the Melvin L. Schottenstein family interests.
The company said the purchase price will be the July 30 closing price of 12-13/16.

After this repurchase, said the company, Irving E. Schottenstein; Robert H. Schottenstein, M/I's president; Steven Schottenstein, M/I's senior executive vice-president; and their families will hold 36 percent of the company's shares, while the Melvin L. Schottenstein family interest will be reduced to 16 percent.
M/I Schottenstein Homes Inc. is a builder of single family homes with operations in Ohio, Indiana, Florida, North Carolina, Virginia, Maryland and Arizona.
